source.title: Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Only Rural Contest in Clady")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name and label checked against the page image (the right edge of the column is faint at the binding); returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1958: 28 nominations for the 30 seats other than Clady, the only contest; the retiring members for Corporation West and Tullyroan were deemed re-elected. Returned unopposed. The label is illegible at the edge of the page. J. J. Allen: no party label printed in 1958. At other elections he stood as Unionist (South-East Ward, Armagh Urban District, 18 May 1955, printed 'U.': Armagh Guardian, 6 May 1955, p. 1 ("Armagh Council elections: no opposition for Unionists"; "To be returned unopposed"); South-East Ward, Armagh Urban District, 21 May 1958, printed 'all Unionist': Armagh Guardian, 9 May 1958, p. 5 ("Armagh City Council elections: contests in two wards, Unionists unopposed")).
